_metadata.description: Phase 3 system mapping for all builtin modules except adventure, buildertools, and hytalegenerator

portals.description: Portal/fragment world system with void event mechanics. Players use portal devices to open procedural fragment worlds, with cursed items, timed fragments, and void invasion events.

PortalDevice.description: Block component for portal device blocks, stores config and destination world UUID

VoidEvent.description: Tracks active void event state on an entity

VoidSpawner.description: Manages void spawner portals during void events

PortalWorld.description: World-level resource tracking portal fragment data (remaining time, existence)

interactions.PortalReturn: ReturnPortalInteraction - returns from a portal world

chunk_store: PortalInvalidDestinationSystem - turns off portals when destination world is removed
CloseWorldWhenBreakingDeviceSystems.ComponentRemoved - closes fragment world when portal device component removed
CloseWorldWhenBreakingDeviceSystems.EntityRemoved - closes fragment world when portal device entity removed
entity_store: PortalTrackerSystems.TrackerSystem - tracks portal state
PortalTrackerSystems.UiTickingSystem - ticks portal UI updates
DiedInPortalSystem - handles player death in portal worlds
CurseItemDropsSystem - curses item drops in portal worlds
DeleteCursedItemsOnSpawnSystem - deletes cursed items on respawn
VoidEventRefSystem - manages void event entity references
VoidInvasionPortalsSpawnSystem - spawns invasion portals during void events
VoidSpawnerSystems.Instantiate - instantiates void spawners
StartVoidEventInFragmentSystem - triggers void events in fragments
VoidEventStagesSystem - manages void event stage progression

cross_references.instances: Uses InstancesPlugin for world removal and exit, PortalRemovalCondition registered with RemovalCondition.CODEC
cross_references.world_map: PortalMarkerProvider adds portal markers to world map

spatial_utilities.description: Custom spatial query framework for portal spawn finding

config_types.PortalDeviceConfig: Configuration for portal devices (JSON-driven via BuilderCodec)
config_types.VoidEventStage: Defines stages of a void event
config_types.InvasionPortalConfig: Configuration for invasion portals during void events

path.description: Path/patrol system for NPCs. Manages prefab paths (placed via world generation or builder tools) and world paths. Entities like PatrolPathMarkerEntity define waypoints.

WorldPathData.description: World-level resource storing all prefab path collections

SpatialResource<Ref, EntityStore>.description: KDTree-based spatial index for prefab paths

entities.PatrolPathMarker: PatrolPathMarkerEntity - waypoint marker entity for patrol paths, serialized with path ID, name, index, observation angle

entity_store: PrefabPathSystems.AddOrRemove - handles adding/removing path markers
PrefabPathSystems.AddedFromWorldGen - handles world-gen placed paths
PathSpatialSystem - maintains spatial index of path markers
PrefabPathSystems.NameplateHolderSystem - manages nameplates on path markers
PrefabPathSystems.NameplateRefChangeSystem - updates nameplate refs
PrefabPathSystems.WorldGenChangeSystem - handles world gen ID changes
PrefabPathSystems.PrefabPlaceEntityEventSystem - handles prefab paste entity events
PrefabPasteEventSystem - processes prefab paste events for path compaction

cross_references.buildertools: Conditionally registers PrefabPathCommand only if BuilderToolsPlugin is enabled. Depends on BuilderToolsPlugin.PrefabPasteEventSystem ordering.
cross_references.npc: PatrolPathMarkerEntity implements IPrefabPathWaypoint used by NPC patrol AI

path_types.IPrefabPath: Interface for prefab-placed paths with waypoint management
path_types.PatrolPath: Concrete patrol path with concurrent waypoint tracking
path_types.TransientPath: Temporary paths built from relative waypoint definitions
path_types.TransientPathDefinition: Definition for building transient paths from relative waypoints

npccombatactionevaluator.description: NPC combat AI evaluation system. Provides a utility-based combat action evaluator that selects optimal combat actions (abilities, basic attacks, state changes) based on target memory, damage memory, and positioning.

TargetMemory.description: Tracks known hostile/friendly targets with decay over time

CombatActionEvaluator.description: Evaluates and selects combat actions for NPCs

CombatConstructionData.description: Temporary construction data for combat evaluator initialization

DamageMemory.description: Tracks recent and total sustained damage for combat decisions

CombatActionOption.description: JSON-configured combat action options with weighted selection

conditions: KnownTargetCount - checks number of known hostile targets

entity_store: TargetMemorySystems.Ticking - decays target memory entries over time
CombatActionEvaluatorSystems.EvaluatorTick - evaluates and selects combat actions each tick
DamageMemorySystems.CollectDamage - collects damage events into damage memory
CombatActionEvaluatorSystems.OnAdded - initializes combat evaluator when CombatConstructionData added

cross_references.npc: Registers core component types on NPCPlugin. Uses NPCPlugin sensors/actions framework.

combat_actions.AbilityCombatAction: Triggers a specific NPC ability interaction
combat_actions.CombatActionOption: JSON-configured weighted combat action with conditions

mounts.description: Mounting system for entities and blocks. Supports NPC mounts (rideable creatures), block seating (chairs/beds), and minecarts on rails. Handles mount/dismount lifecycle, input forwarding, and movement overrides.

BlockMountComponent.description: Tracks entities seated on a block with mount points

NPCMountComponent.description: NPC mount config storing original role index and anchor position

MountedComponent.description: Attached to entities that are currently mounted on something (entity or block)

MountedByComponent.description: Tracks which entities are passengers of this entity

MinecartComponent.description: Minecart entity data including hit count and source item

interactions.SpawnMinecart: SpawnMinecartInteraction - spawns minecart entity on rails
interactions.Mount: MountInteraction - mounts player on entity with configurable offset/controller
interactions.Seating: SeatingInteraction - seats player on block mount point

entity_store: NPCMountSystems.OnAdd - initializes NPC mount when component added
NPCMountSystems.DismountOnPlayerDeath - dismounts on player death
NPCMountSystems.DismountOnMountDeath - dismounts when mount dies
NPCMountSystems.OnPlayerRemove - handles player removal while mounted
MountSystems.TrackerUpdate - updates entity tracker for mounted entities
MountSystems.TrackerRemove - removes tracker for mounted entities
MountSystems.RemoveMountedBy - cleans up MountedByComponent
MountSystems.RemoveMounted - cleans up MountedComponent
MountSystems.RemoveMountedHolder - removes mounted holder
MountSystems.TeleportMountedEntity - teleports mounted entity with mount
MountSystems.MountedEntityDeath - handles death of mounted entity
MountSystems.PlayerMount - player mount input handling
MountSystems.HandleMountInput - forwards player input to mount
MountSystems.TrackedMounted - tracks mounted relationship
MountSystems.EnsureMinecartComponents - ensures minecart has required components
MountSystems.OnMinecartHit - handles minecart being hit (break after 3 hits)
chunk_store: MountSystems.RemoveBlockSeat - removes block seat when block destroyed

cross_references.npc: Registers Mount core component type. Uses NPCEntity and RoleChangeSystem for mount/dismount role transitions.
cross_references.beds: MountedComponent is used by beds for sleeping (bed seating)

api.BlockMountAPI: Static utility for mounting entities on blocks with mount point selection

instances.description: Instance/dungeon system. Creates temporary world instances from asset templates, manages player teleportation in/out, world lifecycle with configurable removal conditions, and instance discovery events.

InstanceBlock.description: Block that links to an instance world by UUID

InstanceEntityConfig.description: Per-entity instance config storing return point

InstanceDataResource.description: Tracks whether instance has had players (for removal)

removal_conditions.WorldEmpty: WorldEmptyCondition - removes when no players present

respawn_controller.ExitInstance: ExitInstance - respawn controller that exits instance on death

chunk_store: InstanceBlock.OnRemove - handles instance block removal
ConfigurableInstanceBlock.OnRemove - handles configurable instance block removal
RemovalSystem - evaluates removal conditions and removes instances

cross_references.portals: Portals use instances for fragment worlds via spawnInstance()
cross_references.creativehub: Creative hub spawns instances via InstancesPlugin.spawnInstance()
cross_references.blockphysics: Uses WorldValidationUtil for instance asset validation

config_types.InstanceWorldConfig: World plugin config with return point, removal conditions, discovery config
config_types.InstanceDiscoveryConfig: Discovery notification config (title, subtitle, sound, duration)
config_types.WorldReturnPoint: Stores return world UUID, position, and reconnection prevention flag
config_types.ExitInstance: RespawnController that teleports player out of instance on death

asseteditor.description: In-game asset editor for live editing game assets (block types, models, textures, sounds, UI, NPC roles, etc.). Supports JSON editing, undo/redo, multi-client editing, asset pack management, and schema-driven validation.

asset_type_handlers: AssetStoreTypeHandler - handles all registered asset stores
CommonAssetTypeHandler - handles Texture (.png), Model (.blockymodel), Animation (.blockyanim), Sound (.ogg), UI (.ui), Language (.lang)
JsonTypeHandler - base handler for JSON-based assets

cross_references.npceditor: NPCEditorPlugin registers NPCRoleAssetTypeHandler and listens for asset selection events

key_types.EditorClient: Represents a connected editor client with permissions
key_types.AssetPath: Record of packId + path identifying an asset
key_types.AssetTree: Builds file tree for editor UI
key_types.AssetTypeRegistry: Registry of all asset type handlers
key_types.DataSource: Interface for reading asset pack data
key_types.StandardDataSource: Default DataSource implementation backed by filesystem
key_types.ModifiedAsset: Tracks modified/new/deleted asset state with timestamps

beds.description: Bed and sleep system. Players interact with beds to set respawn points and sleep. Sleep advances world time through a somnolence state machine (Awake -> NoddingOff -> Slumber -> MorningWakeUp).

PlayerSomnolence.description: Per-player sleep state (FullyAwake, NoddingOff, Slumber, MorningWakeUp)

SleepTracker.description: Tracks last sent sleep packet to avoid redundant updates

WorldSomnolence.description: World-level sleep state (Awake or WorldSlumber with time progression)

interactions.Bed: BedInteraction - handles bed interaction for sleeping and respawn point setting

entity_store: RegisterTrackerSystem - adds SleepTracker to players
WakeUpOnDismountSystem - wakes player when dismounting from bed
EnterBedSystem - transitions player to NoddingOff when mounting bed
UpdateSleepPacketSystem - sends sleep state packets to players
StartSlumberSystem - transitions world to Slumber when enough players are sleeping
UpdateWorldSlumberSystem - advances world time during slumber
SleepNotificationSystem - sends sleep status notifications

cross_references.mounts: Uses MountedComponent for bed mounting/dismounting. BedInteraction uses BlockMountAPI for seating.

sleep_state_machine.PlayerSleep: Sealed interface: FullyAwake | NoddingOff | Slumber | MorningWakeUp
sleep_state_machine.WorldSlumber: Tracks slumber start/target instants and real-time progress

respawn_pages: RespawnPointPage - base page for respawn point UI
SetNameRespawnPointPage - set name for respawn point
SelectOverrideRespawnPointPage - select which respawn to override

crafting.description: Crafting system supporting multiple bench types (Simple, Diagram, Structural, Processing, Field/Pocket). Manages recipe registries per bench, player known recipes, bench upgrade tiers, and crafting windows.

CraftingManager.description: Per-player crafting state manager tracking open bench windows

block_states.ProcessingBenchState: Block state for processing benches (active recipe, progress)
block_states.BenchState: Block state for crafting benches (bench type, upgrade level, stored items)

entity_store: PlayerCraftingSystems.CraftingTickingSystem - ticks crafting managers
PlayerCraftingSystems.CraftingHolderSystem - manages crafting component lifecycle
PlayerCraftingSystems.CraftingRefSystem - handles crafting ref changes
PlayerAddedSystem - sends known recipes when player joins

cross_references.adventure.memories: CraftingManager and CraftingWindow reference MemoriesPlugin for memory-based crafting integration

window_types.SimpleCraftingWindow: Basic grid crafting with material containers

recipe_registry.BenchRecipeRegistry: Per-bench registry mapping categories to recipe sets and tracking valid crafting materials

teleport.description: Teleportation and warp system. Provides /tp, /spawn, and /warp commands with teleport history (back/forward), coordinate teleporting, cross-world teleporting, and persistent warp points saved to warps.json.

TeleportHistory.description: Deque-based teleport history for back/forward navigation (max 100 entries)

WarpComponent.description: Marks an entity as a warp point visualization

commands: tp (to player, to coordinates, other to player, player to coordinates, top, home, back, forward, history, all, world)

systems.none_registered: Teleport uses event-based systems rather than ECS systems

cross_references.world_map: WarpMarkerProvider adds warp markers to world map when DisplayWarps is enabled

warp_system.Warp: Persistent warp point with ID, world, transform, creator, creation date
warp_system.storage: Saved to warps.json (BSON format) in universe directory
warp_system.visualization: Warp entities spawned at chunk pre-load with Warp model, nameplate, intangible, hidden from adventure players

ui.WarpListPage: Interactive UI page for browsing and teleporting to warps

deployables.description: Deployable items system (traps, turrets, AOE effects). Players place deployable entities that interact with the world through proximity triggers, projectile shooting, and area damage.

DeployableComponent.description: Core deployable state with config, flags, lifetime, and tick behavior

DeployableOwnerComponent.description: Tracks deployed items per owner with damage/kill counting

DeployableProjectileShooterComponent.description: Manages turret projectile tracking and target selection

DeployableProjectileComponent.description: Tracks projectile previous position for hit detection

deployable_types.TrapSpawner: DeployableTrapSpawnerConfig - trap that spawns additional entities
deployable_types.Turret: DeployableTurretConfig - auto-targeting turret that shoots projectiles

entity_store: DeployablesSystem.DeployableTicker - ticks deployable behavior (trap detection, turret targeting, AOE pulses)
DeployablesSystem.DeployableRegisterer - registers deployables with owner component on spawn
DeployablesSystem.DeployableOwnerTicker - ticks owner tracking (limit enforcement)

utilities.DeployablesUtils: Static helpers for spawning deployable entities with model, bounding box, hitbox, despawn timer

ambience.description: Ambient sound and music system. Manages ambient emitter entities that play localized sounds, and world-level forced music overrides.

AmbienceTracker.description: Per-player tracker for forced music state

AmbientEmitterComponent.description: Persistent ambient sound emitter with sound event ID

entity_store: AmbientEmitterSystems.EntityAdded - ensures emitter entities have required components
AmbientEmitterSystems.EntityRefAdded - spawns audio entity for emitter
AmbientEmitterSystems.Ticking - ticks emitter state
ForcedMusicSystems.Tick - sends forced music updates to players
ForcedMusicSystems.PlayerAdded - initializes music tracker for new players

config.AmbiencePluginConfig: Server config with AmbientEmitterModel key (default: NPC_Spawn_Marker)

fluid.description: Fluid simulation system. Handles fluid spreading, block interaction, and chunk preprocessing for fluids. Registers fluid ticker types and manages fluid sections.

chunk_store: FluidSystems.EnsureFluidSection - ensures fluid sections exist
FluidSystems.MigrateFromColumn - migrates fluid data from column format
FluidSystems.SetupSection - initializes fluid sections
FluidSystems.LoadPacketGenerator - generates fluid load packets
FluidSystems.ReplicateChanges - replicates fluid changes to clients
FluidSystems.Ticking - ticks fluid simulation per section

fluid.preprocessing: On newly generated chunks, iterates all fluid sections, validates fluid IDs, checks solid blocks, and pre-simulates fluid spreading up to 100 ticks

weather.description: Weather system managing per-world weather states with player position-based environment tracking and forced weather overrides.

WeatherTracker.description: Per-player weather state tracking with UpdateWeather packet management

WeatherResource.description: World-level weather state with forced weather override and environment-based weather map

entity_store: WeatherSystem.WorldAddedSystem - initializes weather for new worlds
WeatherSystem.PlayerAddedSystem - initializes weather tracker for new players
WeatherSystem.TickingSystem - updates weather state and sends packets
WeatherSystem.InvalidateWeatherAfterTeleport - refreshes weather after teleport

parkour.description: Parkour checkpoint system. Manages indexed checkpoints that players must reach in order, with timing and reset support.

entity_store: ParkourCheckpointSystems.EnsureNetworkSendable - ensures checkpoint entities are network visible
ParkourCheckpointSystems.Init - registers checkpoints in plugin's UUID map
ParkourCheckpointSystems.Ticking - checks player proximity to checkpoints using spatial resource

state.currentCheckpointByPlayerMap: Object2IntMap<UUID> tracking each player's current checkpoint
state.checkpointUUIDMap: Int2ObjectMap<UUID> mapping checkpoint index to entity UUID

blockspawner.description: Block-based entity spawning. Replaces placeholder blocks with actual blocks from weighted spawn tables when chunks load, with rotation inheritance/randomization.

BlockSpawner.description: Block component storing spawner table ID

BlockSpawnerTable.description: Weighted table of block entries with rotation modes

chunk_store: BlockSpawnerSystem - on block added, rolls weighted table and replaces spawner block with result
MigrateBlockSpawner - migration system for old 'blockspawner' unknown component format

spawner_entry.BlockSpawnerEntry: Entry with block name, rotation mode (NONE/RANDOM/INHERIT), weight, optional block components

model.description: Model management plugin. Provides /model command for changing entity models and hot-reloads model assets when they change.
model.hot_reload: On model asset change, iterates all entities with ModelComponent across all worlds and updates their models

ui.ChangeModelPage: Interactive UI for searching and selecting models with entity preview spawning

commandmacro.description: Command macro system. Loads macro command definitions from JSON assets and dynamically registers them as server commands with parameter substitution.

MacroCommandBuilder.description: JSON-defined command macros with parameters and replacements

macro_types.MacroCommandBuilder: Defines macro name, sub-commands, parameters, and replacements
macro_types.MacroCommandBase: Runtime command that executes macro sub-commands with parameter substitution
macro_types.MacroCommandParameter: Defines a parameter with name, type, and description
macro_types.MacroCommandReplacement: Defines string replacements applied to command text

blockphysics.description: Block physics system handling gravity-affected blocks and prefab validation. Validates prefab assets on server startup.

chunk_store: BlockPhysicsSystems.Ticking - processes block physics ticks

validation.PrefabBufferValidator: Validates all prefabs checking block states and block types. Fires ValidateBlockEvent.
validation.WorldValidationUtil: Block validator utility used by instances for world validation

creativehub.description: Creative hub system. Provides a hub world that players spawn into, with portal-based navigation to sub-worlds and a 'Return to Hub' button UI.

CreativeHubEntityConfig.description: Per-entity config storing parent hub world UUID

interactions.HubPortal: HubPortalInteraction - teleports player to/from hub instances

world_config.CreativeHub: CreativeHubWorldConfig - world config with startup instance name

entity_store: ReturnToHubButtonSystem - manages return-to-hub button visibility

cross_references.instances: Uses InstancesPlugin.spawnInstance() for hub instances, InstanceWorldConfig, InstanceEntityConfig, WorldReturnPoint

features.hub_instances: Maintains map of parent world UUID -> active hub instance world
features.permanent_worlds: spawnPermanentWorldFromTemplate() creates non-deletable worlds from instance templates
features.return_button: ReturnToHubButtonUI sends custom UI packet for hub return button

blocktick.description: Block tick system for deterministic block updates (growth, state changes). Discovers ticking blocks in newly generated chunks and processes them via tick procedures.

tick_procedures.SplitChance: SplitChanceBlockGrowthProcedure - split chance growth with multiple outcomes

chunk_store: ChunkBlockTickSystem.PreTick - pre-tick processing
ChunkBlockTickSystem.Ticking - main block tick processing
MergeWaitingBlocksSystem - merges deferred ticking blocks

blocktick.integration: Sets BlockTickManager.blockTickProvider to self, providing tick procedures from BlockType assets

randomtick.description: Random tick system for non-deterministic block updates (spreading, decay). Processes random blocks per chunk per tick.

random_tick_procedures.ChangeIntoBlock: ChangeIntoBlockProcedure - transforms block into another type
random_tick_procedures.SpreadTo: SpreadToProcedure - spreads block type to adjacent positions

chunk_store: RandomTickSystem - selects random blocks in loaded chunks and applies their random tick procedures

tagset.description: Tag set system for categorizing NPCs into groups with efficient bitwise lookup. Used for attitude/faction systems.

key_types.TagSetLookupTable: Builds flattened Int2ObjectMap<IntSet> for O(1) tag-in-set checks
key_types.TagSetPlugin.TagSetLookup: Runtime lookup with tagInSet(int tagSet, int tagIndex) method
key_types.NPCGroup: Concrete tag set implementation for NPC groups

crouchslide.description: Crouch slide movement feature. Registers ClientFeature.CrouchSlide and 'Allows=Movement' client tag.

mantling.description: Mantling movement feature. Registers ClientFeature.Mantling and 'Allows=Movement' client tag.

safetyroll.description: Safety roll movement feature. Registers ClientFeature.SafetyRoll and 'Allows=Movement' client tag.

sprintforce.description: Sprint force movement feature. Registers ClientFeature.SprintForce.

landiscovery.description: LAN discovery system. Runs a UDP multicast listener on port 5510 that responds to HYTALE_DISCOVER_REQUEST packets with server info.

networking.reply_contents: IP address, port, server name, player count, max players

npceditor.description: NPC role editor integration for the asset editor. Registers NPCRole asset type handler and provides model preview when selecting NPC roles.

asset_type_handlers: NPCRoleAssetTypeHandler (type: NPCRole, path: NPC roles, extension: .json)

cross_references.npc: Uses NPCPlugin for role building, validation, and model preview

worldgen.description: World generation plugin. Registers BiomeDataSystem and HytaleWorldGenProvider, loads versioned world generation asset packs from $Versions directory.

versioning.description: Loads versioned worldgen packs from Server/WorldGen/$Versions/, validates version numbers, registers as asset packs

cross_module_summary.portal_instance_chain: portals -> instances -> creativehub: Portals spawn fragment instances, creative hub spawns hub instances, both use InstancesPlugin.spawnInstance()
cross_module_summary.mount_bed_integration: mounts <-> beds: Beds use MountedComponent for sleeping, EnterBedSystem and WakeUpOnDismountSystem react to mount state changes
cross_module_summary.npc_combat_chain: npccombatactionevaluator -> npc: Combat evaluator registers core NPC components (sensors, actions, collectors) via NPCPlugin
cross_module_summary.path_npc_integration: path -> npc: PatrolPathMarkerEntity provides waypoints for NPC patrol AI via IPrefabPathWaypoint interface
cross_module_summary.asset_editor_ecosystem: asseteditor <-> npceditor <-> weather: Asset editor provides editing infrastructure, NPC editor adds role editing, weather integrates preview locking
cross_module_summary.block_tick_systems: blocktick + randomtick + fluid + blockspawner + blockphysics: Five separate block processing systems that all operate on ChunkStore with different scheduling strategies
cross_module_summary.movement_features: crouchslide + mantling + safetyroll + sprintforce: Four movement feature plugins that register ClientFeature flags
cross_module_summary.crafting_adventure: crafting -> adventure.memories: Crafting windows and managers reference MemoriesPlugin for memory-based crafting
